reference_sql:
SELECT category_id,
       brand,
       unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE category_id IN (15, 16)
ORDER BY category_id, brand, unit_cost_eur DESC
alternatives: SELECT category_id, brand, unit_cost_eur FROM products WHERE category_id = 15 OR category_id = 16 ORDER BY category_id, brand, unit_cost_eur DESC
SELECT category_id, brand, unit_cost_eur FROM products WHERE category_id IN (15, 16) ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 DESC
SELECT category_id, brand, unit_cost_eur FROM products WHERE category_id BETWEEN 15 AND 16 ORDER BY category_id ASC, brand ASC, unit_cost_eur DESC NULLS LAST
